Pushed a follow-up commit hardening the extraction.

Two things beyond the original spaced-colon fix:

- The script runs under `set -euo pipefail`. When the API returns 200 without a `builder_code`, the failing `grep` pipeline aborts the script at that assignment, so the `[ -z "$BUILDER_CODE" ]` check right below never runs and the response fails silently with no message. Added a `|| BUILDER_CODE=""` fallback so the check runs and prints the intended `Error: No builder_code in API response`. (This is pre-existing: the previous single-space `grep -o` line had the same behavior.)
- Switched ` *` to `[[:space:]]*`, so a tab after the colon is handled too, not only a space.

Verified locally: no-code response reaches the guard with a clear error; both space- and tab-separated JSON extract the code correctly; `bash -n` clean.
